description: Get contracts from Poland's Central Register of Contracts (CRU JSFP, Ministry of Finance) where the company is the contractor of a public-sector unit (ministries, municipalities, schools, hospitals) — count, total value, top public buyers and the 50 most recent contracts (date, subject, value in PLN, buyer, link). Register live since July 2026; covers contracts below tender thresholds too. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.
